summary: Iteration 7 — Richer Bird Detail upgrade FULLY VERIFIED end-to-end. Backend /api/birds/enrich returns 200 with ALL 7 new fields populated for Northern Cardinal: behavior, sexDifferences, weight (42-48 g), lifespan (3-6 years), seasonality, populationTrend ('Stable'), confusedWith (4 items: Pyrrhuloxia, Scarlet Tanager, Summer Tanager, Vermilion Flycatcher) — plus pre-existing howToIdentify/diet/habitat/nestingBehavior/funFacts/conservationStatus ('Least Concern'). Frontend Description tab default → after ~15s enrichment lands, ALL 9 expandable cards present (Overview, How to identify, Key facts, Diet, Habitat, Behavior & personality, Male vs female, Nesting, When to look). Conservation card shows 'Least Concern' with green dot + 'Stable' trend chip with trending icon. Scientific classification card shows all 4 rows correctly (Order: Passeriformes, Family: Cardinalidae (Cardinals and Allies), Genus: Cardinalis, Species: Cardinalis cardinalis in italic). 'Often confused with' horizontal scroller renders 4 species cards with real Wikipedia photos via SpeciesThumb, common name, and distinguishing tip — tapping confused card (Scarlet Tanager) successfully navigates to /bird/scarlet-tanager and that page enriches correctly. 'Did you know?' card lists 3 fun facts with sparkles icons. Ask Owl CTA card visible, sage-tinted, testID='bird-ask-owl' — tapping navigates to /chat?birdId=northern-cardinal&birdName=Northern%20Cardinal&birdSci=Cardinalis%20cardinalis. Chat welcome message correctly reads 'We're looking at the Northern Cardinal (Cardinalis cardinalis). Ask me anything: how to attract it, how to tell it apart from look-alikes...' Range tab shows 'Where to find it' card with rangeSummary + Seasonality line, 'Activity by month' card with sage 'May today' pill, all 12 month pills (Jan-Dec, testID='bird-month-{lower}'), current month May outlined in sage, helper 'Most likely seen this month.' when current month active and 'Switch months to see how the range shifts.' when another month tapped. Regression: bird detail loads INSTANTLY for precached Northern Cardinal (hero image + name visible immediately), all 4 tabs (Photos/Description/Sounds/Range) switch correctly, back button works (testID='bird-detail-back'). Cache version bump verified — localStorage shows only 'bird:ai:v2:*' and 'bird:detail:v2:*' keys, no leftover v1 keys. Backend pytest: 8/8 passing (6 regression + 2 new enrich-schema tests).

react_native_issues.issue: Web console warning '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"' still appears (pre-existing from prior iterations, not introduced by this change). React-native-web specific; native iOS/Android unaffected.

action_items: OPTIONAL polish: The 'Offline ready' badge (detail.source === 'precached') flashes for ~1 frame on first paint then disappears because loadFullDetail unconditionally sets detail.source = 'live' (or 'partial') after enrichment finishes. If you want the badge to stay visible after enrichment for precached species, capture wasPrecached at instant-detail time and key the badge on that flag instead of the mutable detail.source. Not blocking — purely a polish nit.

MINOR (review request wording): The review request listed 'testID="confused-birdscan-pro"' which appears to be a typo. Actual implementation uses 'confused-{scientific-name-lowercased-with-dashes}' (e.g. 'confused-cardinalis-sinuatus', 'confused-piranga-olivacea'). This is the correct/sensible pattern — confirming the testID format with main agent for documentation accuracy.
critical_code_review_comments: bird/[id].tsx is 693 lines — getting close to the 700-line soft limit. The Description tab + its sub-components (ExpandableCard, ClassificationRow, ConfusedCard, AskOwlCard, IUCN_COLORS) could be moved into /app/frontend/src/components/bird-description/ for better separation. Not urgent.

iucnColor() supports 7 IUCN buckets (least concern → extinct) — good coverage. Fallback uses colors.primary for unknown statuses; consider colors.textTertiary so unknown values don't look like a real category.
ConfusedCard lookup via lookupByScientific then lookupByCommon is solid; falls back to a leaf icon if neither resolves — graceful.

Range tab activeMonth state is independent from system date, so tapping months changes UI highlight; current-month outlined ring (monthPillToday) stays visible underneath when activeMonth != currentMonth — nice progressive disclosure.
Cache key uses VERSION='v2' on BOTH cacheKey (bird:detail:v2:*) and aiCacheKey (bird:ai:v2:*) — verified at runtime that no v1 keys remain after upgrade. Bump is correct.
fetchAi catches errors and stores null in cache only if request succeeds — correct, no negative caching.
Backend enrich endpoint reliably returns the new 7 fields for Northern Cardinal in ~6s — well within the 15s budget.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — all 9 acceptance items + 3 regression items pass

context_for_next_testing_agent: Bird detail page is at /bird/{id}; mobile viewport 412x915 works. Onboarding bypass: tap 'Continue' x4 + 'Get Started' then close paywall via [data-testid="paywall-close-button"]. To validate AI enrichment, wait ~15s after page load before checking new section text. Cache lives in localStorage under bird:detail:v2:* and bird:ai:v2:* — to force a refetch, clear localStorage. Confused-with cards have testID='confused-{scientific-name-with-dashes-lowercased}' (e.g. confused-cardinalis-sinuatus). Ask Owl CTA testID='bird-ask-owl' navigates to /chat with birdId/birdName/birdSci query params; chat.tsx greets with bird context when params present.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no functional issues. One polish nit (precached badge flashes off after enrichment) and one documentation discrepancy (testID naming in the review request appears to be a typo).
